no_drivers: No INDI drivers found (drivers.xml not available).
files_no_selection: Select an image to view metadata
focus_no_frame: No focus frame yet — click Capture or Loop
imaging_toggle_preview_title: Show or hide the last captured frame
imaging_no_frame: No frame yet — tap Preview, Loop or Start
imaging_empty_queue: No jobs yet — build a sequence in the Editor, or load one.
seq_err_values: Fix the sequence rows marked in red: gain, offset, delay and binning must be numbers ≥ 0, a dither interval a whole number ≥ 1.
seq_limits_hint: Ekos applies these when the sequence loads, and keeps them until another sequence changes them.
seq_refocus_temp: Refocus when the temperature changes by
seq_hfr_check: Refocus when the HFR rises (HFR check)
seq_guide_abort: Abort the exposure if guiding drifts over
seq_guide_start: Start only once guiding drift is under
seq_err_limits: Fix the focus & guiding values marked in red: each must be a number > 0, the minutes a whole number.
seq_end_hint: KStars runs this script after the last frame (needs dbus-send on the KStars machine):
seq_err_end: The script for after the last frame isn't written — pick the option again, or Leave as is.
pa_manual_rotate_instr: Rotate the mount by the configured angle, then click Done.
guide_capture_loop_note: Capture / Loop require the Internal guider. PHD2 handles framing itself.
guide_dither_note: No “dither now” button — the Ekos Live protocol only exposes dither as an auto-trigger during capture sequences via these settings.
mosaic_cam_no_fov: Camera not connected — tile FOV unknown
mosaic_kstars_fov_note: KStars uses its own persisted scope/camera in the Framing Assistant — if tile spacing differs, open it once and click the INDI fetch button.
mosaic_err_no_center: Pick a center on the sky first.
mosaic_err_no_frames: Add at least one sequence row with numeric exposure and count.
mosaic_err_no_fov: Camera FOV unknown — connect camera and wait for CCD_INFO.
mosaic_pick_hint: Tap the sky to set the mosaic center
sched_no_jobs: No scheduled jobs. Add one below or load a schedule in KStars.
sched_log_empty: No log yet. Start the scheduler to see activity here.
sched_q_preset_startup: Standard startup (unpark dome, mount, dust cap)
sched_q_preset_shutdown: Standard shutdown (park dust cap, mount, dome)
sched_q_no_steps: No steps yet — add one below.
sched_q_devices_note: This slot runs while INDI is stopped, so only waits and scripts can run here.
sched_q_device_warning: This queue has device steps, which KStars cannot run in this slot (the scheduler would stall). Remove them before saving.
sched_q_foreign_note: The slot currently points at a file Junos doesn't manage. Saving creates a new queue and assigns it instead:
sched_q_confirm_overwrite: a queue with this name already exists. Overwrite it?
sched_q_confirm_delete: delete this queue? Its scripts are kept.
sched_q_confirm_overwrite_script: a script with this name already exists, maybe used by another queue. Overwrite it?
sched_proc_pick: Pick a stage of the night to design its queue.
sched_proc_intro: KStars runs these queues around each scheduler session. Switches and queue choices are sent at once.
sched_q_indi_offline: Start Ekos to pick devices and properties from lists — typing their names works too.
sched_q_indi_turns_on: Turns this choice on (and the others off).
sched_q_native_note: This queue has custom INDI steps, so it is saved in KStars' queue format: there, a built-in step whose device isn't connected stops the queue.
sched_q_err_indi_incomplete: enter the device, property and element.
sched_q_err_indi_value: the value doesn't fit this type (only numbers, texts and switches can be set).
sched_q_err_unknown_queue: this unsupported task can't be kept in a queue with custom INDI steps — remove it.
sched_q_err_name: File name: 1–64 characters among A–Z, a–z, 0–9, _ and - (not starting with -).
sched_q_err_reserved: This name is reserved for KStars' built-in procedure.
sched_q_err_no_steps: Add at least one step, or clear the slot instead.
sched_q_err_device_slot: device steps cannot run in this slot.
sched_q_err_script_name: script name: 1–64 characters among A–Z, a–z, 0–9, _ and -.
sched_q_err_script_dup: two scripts in this queue share that name.
sched_q_err_shebang: the script must start with an interpreter line such as #!/usr/bin/env bash.
sched_q_err_script_path: enter the absolute path of an executable on the KStars host.
sched_q_err_loading: Still loading — try again in a moment.
sched_q_err_no_server: junos-server did not report its task-queue folder — cannot save.
sched_alt_hint: Enter coordinates to see the target's altitude tonight.
sched_alt_ref_note: Indicative — the job still starts per its start condition.
sched_err_ra: RA must be a number between 0 and 24 (hours).
sched_err_dec: Dec must be a number between −90 and +90 (degrees).
sched_err_frames: Add at least one valid sequence frame (numeric exposure and count).
sched_err_flat_adu: ADU flats need a target ADU between 1 and 65535 and a tolerance ≥ 0.
sched_err_flat_encoding: ADU flats need FITS or XISF encoding — KStars cannot measure ADU on other formats.
files_resolve_slew_confirm: Plate-solve this image and slew the mount to its framing?
livestack_preview_hint: Watching the output directory for new frames
livestack_out_of_sandbox: Path is outside the captures sandbox — preview unavailable
files_folder_hint: Select a folder to access Live Stack controls
pa_meridian_warn: Meridian crossing likely — reverse the direction, reduce the rotation or point further from the meridian.
rig_offline_hint: Start a profile to manage its rigs.
framing_no_fov: Connect a scope and camera to compute the field of view.
focus_chart_caption: HFR per sample. X axis is the focuser position when the focuser reports one, otherwise the sample order.
plan_empty_schedules: None yet — save one from the Scheduler tab.
plan_empty_sequences: None yet — each job added in Scheduler or Mosaic writes one.
plan_empty_queues: None yet — create one in Scheduler › Startup & shutdown.
plan_empty_scripts: None yet — the startup / shutdown queue editor writes them.
plan_offline: Start Ekos to load files into KStars
plan_confirm_load_schedule: Load this schedule? It replaces the Scheduler's job list.
plan_confirm_load_sequence: Load this sequence? It replaces the Imaging queue.
plan_load_failed: KStars could not load this file
plan_no_reply: No reply from KStars — is Ekos started?
plan_no_path: The file's location on the host is unknown.
plan_confirm_delete_sequence: Delete this sequence? Scheduler jobs and schedules that use it will fail.
plan_confirm_delete_queue: Delete this queue? A startup / shutdown slot that uses it will fail. Its scripts are kept.
plan_confirm_delete_script: Delete this script? Queues that run it will fail.
plan_save_hint: KStars writes the whole job list with its startup and shutdown procedures. Find it in Files › Planning.
plan_confirm_overwrite: A schedule with this name exists. Overwrite it?
plan_nothing_written: Nothing written: KStars has no changes since the schedule was last saved or loaded.
plan_no_home: junos-server reported no home folder — cannot save.
targets_bands_hint: Only objects that show strongly in one of the selected bands.
targets_weights_hint: 0 ignores a criterion, 3 makes it dominant.
targets_empty: No object matches this window and these filters.
targets_peak_title: Highest altitude in the window, and when
targets_adv_broadband: Broadband: L-RGB, or a colour camera without a filter. Narrowband filters add nothing.
targets_adv_broadband_ha: Broadband (L-RGB); an Hα layer brings out its HII regions.
targets_adv_ha: Narrowband, Hα first (+ SII for SHO): copes with the Moon and light pollution.
targets_adv_dual: Hα + OIII: a dual-band filter on a colour camera, or HOO / SHO in mono.
targets_adv_oiii: OIII first, then Hα: dual-band or HOO. OIII suffers most from the Moon.
targets_adv_mixed: L-RGB for the reflection and the stars, blended with Hα for the emission.
targets_adv_unknown: Nature not catalogued: try Hα and broadband.
